idea-plugin.name: Samsad ADB Controller
idea-plugin.description:
Fast, offline ADB control panel for Android Studio & IntelliJ IDEA.
Features:
  • Connected Device Manager: Auto-detects connected emulators & physical devices.
  • App Actions Grid: 1-click Clear App Data, Force Restart, Force Stop, and Uninstall.
  • Device Utilities Grid: 1-click Toggle Dark Mode, Toggle Layout Bounds, Toggle Animations, and Screenshot to Clipboard.
  • Auto Package Detection: Detects app applicationId / namespace from project files automatically.
